title: Character
description: One person. Characters are the centre of this game: titles pass between them, opinion is held by them, and the scenario is the state of a family tree on a single day.

name.description: Given name only. The dynasty supplies the family name.

death.description: Null means the character is alive at the scenario start date and their death is not yet scripted.

spouses.description: Every marriage, living or ended. Version 0 does not model when a marriage began or how it ended.

traits.description: Version 0 carries the twelve virtue and vice pairs only. Congenital traits, lifestyle traits, and illnesses are out of scope until an engine exists to apply their effects.
